title: The RefinedWeb Dataset for Falcon LLM
authors: G. Penedo, Q. Malartic, D. Hesslow, et al. (9 authors)
before: Best practice mixed filtered web text with curated sources like books and Wikipedia.
problem: Curated corpora are small and legally awkward; is the curation actually necessary?
breakthrough: Aggressive filtering and deduplication of web data alone, matching or beating models trained on curated mixes.
why: It reframed data quality as a filtering problem rather than a sourcing problem, which is how the field now treats it.
next: Dolma and FineWeb refined the same pipeline in the open.
inherits: Web-only pretraining data with heavy filtering.
